name: Arizona Water Protection Fund (ADWR)
program: Annual grant cycle: capital projects, research and water conservation for Arizona rivers and riparian areas
collect_note: Page watch only, and it may not be able to read the page: every azwpf.gov and azwater.gov URL (home, grant pages, PDFs, robots.txt, sitemap.xml, rss, jsonapi) answers HTTP 403 with a Cloudflare managed challenge (Cf-Mitigated: challenge) to plain HTTP, so no calls listing, feed, API or sitemap can be read without a browser. Calls are applied for in a login-gated eCivis portal, not listed publicly. The Commission opens one cycle a year (manual in May, applications due mid-August); a person should check the Grant Information pages by browser each spring.
evidence: Plain HTTP GET 2026-11-12 with desktop UA: https://www.azwpf.gov/, azwpf.gov, new.azwater.gov, azwater.gov, /robots.txt, /sitemap.xml, /rss.xml, /jsonapi, grant manual PDF all = 403, body 'Just a moment...', header Cf-Mitigated: challenge. endpoint_recon (--no-chrome, Chrome port 9333 down) found no endpoint (page 403, sitemap 403). The eCivis link on the grant page (gn.ecivis.com/GO/gn_redir/T/ow03q6lj2ia9) = 200 but is a Euna Grants login landing page with no public opportunity list. Grants.gov does not carry state funds. Only the Wayback Machine copy of the official pages could be read (azwpf.gov/grant-information/fy-2026-grant-cycle capture 2025-09-10 lists the cycle schedule with applications due 2025-08-15).
